title: AWS Glue Streaming Job for Real-time NiFi Flows
description: Convert NiFi real-time streaming flows to AWS Glue Streaming ETL jobs consuming from MSK.

steps.action: Create Glue Streaming job: Python shell or Spark Streaming, MSK as source (bootstrap servers from MSK console), Glue catalog connection
steps.verify: Glue job definition saved; IAM role has kafka:GetBootstrapBrokers and msk:* permissions

steps.action: Configure micro-batch window (batchWindow 30-60s) and checkpoint location in S3 for exactly-once processing
steps.verify: S3 checkpoint bucket exists; Glue job starts and writes checkpoint files
steps.rollback: Delete checkpoint files; reset consumer group offset

steps.action: Implement schema validation and transformation logic mirroring NiFi processor chain (JSON parse, field mapping, enrichment)
steps.verify: Test batch run processes 1000 sample messages; output matches NiFi flow expected output format
steps.rollback: Revert to NiFi processor for this flow

steps.action: Enable Glue job bookmarks and configure CloudWatch alarms on job failure and consumer lag > 5000
steps.verify: CloudWatch alarm created; test alarm fires on simulated lag spike
